summary: Dynagas LNG Partners LP filed a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, attaching an October 9 press release announcing an optional partial redemption of its 9.00% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Units. The Partnership will redeem 2,000,000 of 3,000,000 outstanding units at $25.00 per unit in cash on November 12, 2026, leaving 1,000,000 units outstanding. No accumulated distributions are owed because the redemption date coincides with a distribution payment date. Computershare serves as paying agent; DTC holds the single certificate. Watch for post-redemption leverage, remaining float liquidity, and preferred yield dynamics.
